ai_assessment.method: Full direct English-to-Vietnamese comparison of all 73 canonical passages and both titles. Separate subagent drafting from the original preceded review. A separate-context assessor (same model family, not shown the drafter’s notes or scores) read every pair first and reported seven major and about seventy minor findings with a pre-revision weighted score of 8.56; the drafter revised the text, re-read the changed passages and the whole target for naturalness, then assigned these final scores bound to the final byte hashes.
ai_assessment.limitations: The same AI system drafted, revised and assessed the work; the separate-context pass is correlated same-model feedback, not independent review or model diversity. No human literary reviewer, native-reader trial or measured reader demand is claimed. Existing Vietnamese translations were not consulted or collated. Scores are subjective and uncalibrated; missed errors may remain. Source clearance is separately recorded and is not granted by this review.

findings.explanation: The Faith/faith pun was dropped at the first attempt; later attempts added glosses, so the final text keeps the name ‘Faith’ and records the pun as an open note.
A repeated clause and an added epithet were removed.
A trailing clause ‘hold on to faith’ that the English lacks was cut.
An added gloss on ‘Faith below’ was removed.
Magi and wizard were distinguished; constable, ‘Christian’ and communion terms were corrected.
The pun between the name Faith and the virtue is not audible in Vietnamese.

summary: Full assessment of all 73 English/Vietnamese passages, from the sunset farewell at Salem village through the forest road, the witch-meeting and the morning after. The first reviews scored 8.725 (units 1–36) and 8.40 (units 37–73) and found a major in the second half; four further rounds fixed seven majors in all (the dropped Faith pun and three additions or repeats introduced by repairs). A fresh separate-context review of the whole text scored 8.80 with no major or critical finding, and twelve minor points were then applied. On the half-point scale the final score is 8.8, above the unchanged 8.6 threshold. No unresolved major or critical issue remains.

title_review.rationale: The Vietnamese title is this edition’s own rendering of ‘Young Goodman Brown’; the Puritan honorific Goodman is kept. No earlier Vietnamese title was checked.
